items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: he got a hold of Chappy Willett and Ike Dickson to start writing for the band. So I got in the band.

ctx.x: Danny Barker. They got Jerry Baker on the baritone and clarinet. They had a clarinet, and they played good jazz. So he got a hell of a band, and he got a hold of Chappy Willett and Ike Dickson to start writing for the band. So I got in the band.
Dizzy in the meantime, after me, he sees Chick Webb.
